name: Thermal and Power Check
summary: Verify that GPU temperature and power consumption are within safe operating limits during benchmark execution
purpose: Verify that GPU temperature and power consumption are within safe operating limits during benchmark execution.
assignment_instructions: You are checking GPU thermal and power metrics against safe limits. REQUIRED OUTPUT: Return a JSON object with these exact fields: - assignment_id (string): use "compute_thermal_power_check_v1" - agent_summary (string) - inputs_used (list of strings) - missing_inputs (list of strings) - claims (list of objects): claim, evidence_reference, confidence ("provided"|"inferred"|"missing") - calculations (list of objects): name, formula, inputs, result, units, assumptions - risks (list of objects): risk, severity ("low"|"medium"|"high"), evidence_reference - assumptions (list of strings) - open_questions (list of strings) - final_output (string) - self_check (object): all_required_sections_completed (boolean), all_numbers_have_sources (boolean), assumptions_labeled (boolean), missing_inputs_disclosed (boolean) Also include: - gpu_model (string): GPU model name - max_temperature_c (number): maximum temperature observed in degrees Celsius - avg_temperature_c (number): average temperature observed in degrees Celsius - thermal_limit_c (number): thermal limit for this GPU model (default 85) - thermal_safe (boolean): max_temperature_c < thermal_limit_c - max_power_w (number): maximum power draw observed in watts - avg_power_w (number): average power draw observed in watts - power_limit_w (number): power limit for this GPU model - power_within_spec (boolean): max_power_w <= power_limit_w - thermal_throttle_detected (boolean): whether thermal throttling was observed - overall_safe (boolean): thermal_safe and power_within_spec and not thermal_throttle_detected Compute thermal_safe as max_temperature_c < thermal_limit_c (strictly less than). Compute power_within_spec as max_power_w <= power_limit_w. Return numeric values as numbers, not prose. Temperatures and power must be numbers. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.

deterministic_checks.description: All temperature values must be numbers
All power values must be numbers
thermal_safe must be true when max temp is below limit
power_within_spec must be true when max power is at or below limit
overall_safe must be true only when all conditions pass
deterministic_checks.assertion: result.overall_safe == (result.thermal_safe and result.power_within_spec and not result.thermal_throttle_detected)

deterministic_checks.description: Average temperature must not exceed maximum
Average power must not exceed maximum

evidence_checks.description: Must be the actual maximum temperature observed in telemetry
Must be the actual maximum power draw observed in telemetry
Must be based on explicit throttle indicators in logs, not inferred

flag_rules.description: GPU thermal throttling detected during benchmark
All thermal and power metrics within safe limits
